title: Chapter 414: I Took It Away
content:
Chapter 414: I Took It Away

At this moment, the giant house that was originally making noise was silent at this moment, and the needles could be heard.

The demons stared at the human woman blankly, their eyes almost glaring out.

The leader of the Tian Yao tribe opened his mouth wide, and for a moment, he couldn't make a sound.

He didn't expect that this human woman who he had not seen through would have such a terrifying identity.

Lu Xue.

This is the most dazzling name in the Chaos World today.

Even though Lu Xue has not appeared in front of the dead for a long time, no one in the world will forget it.

That is the supreme figure who turned the gods into history!

And at this moment, this supreme person stood in front of him.

I'm afraid even if the ancestors of their Heavenly Demon Clan saw it, they would still be humble.

Bai Ling was also shocked beside Lu Xue.

Although she had known Lu Xue's name for a long time, she didn't know what the name meant because she had little knowledge.

But even so, she was well-known in the Human Emperor Palace.

That is the most powerful race in the Chaos Realm today, the commanding power of the human race!

How could she not know?

Senior Lu Xue turned out to be the founder of the Human Emperor Palace and the first palace master.

At this moment, she finally understood why Lord Aoqing was willing to follow Lu Xue.

When Bai Ling looked at Lu Xuezhi again, there was already a lot of worship in his eyes.

"Lu, Lu, Senior Lu Xue, I,,,"

After reacting for a long time, the patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan stuttered and spoke.

At the same time, the gears in his mind began to rotate again.

What do you think of today’s human race?

It is really hateful. Relying on his own strength, he has repeatedly exploited my Tiande Clan for many years, which made my Tiande Clan leader unable to raise his head in front of the human race.

But how could the leader of the Tian Yao Clan dare to say these things openly?

Say you have no opinion?

That's too fake. I asked Lord Ao Qing for help. Senior Lu naturally knew the embarrassment in the Tiande Clan now.

After a moment of silence, the head of the Tian Yao tribe suddenly burst into tears.

"Wuwuwuwuwu, Senior Lu, my Heavenly Demon Clan has suffered over the years!"

The sudden tears made Lu Xue stunned, and the demons around him were also confused.

Why did the clan leader suddenly cry?

The leader of the Tiande Clan wailed to the sky and then fell to Lu Xue, crying.

"Senior Lu, you don't know how my Tiande Clan got through these years. After experiencing that incident, my Tiande Clan had already begun to decline, and its strength had declined seriously, but my Tiande Clan was I know that if the human race had not done its best back then, how could it have defeated the evil gods?”

"So after the war, my Tian Yao Clan ignored its own safety and must help the human race restore its former glory."

"Just, just,"

The patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan had a painful expression. If Lu Daosheng was here, he would definitely award this guy an Oscar Award for Best Actor.

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan sighed heavily and continued to choke and said, "It's just that my Tian Yao Clan is not good at being strong and has no strength anymore. Now, I'm afraid I can never help the human race anymore."

High, really high.

He is worthy of being the leader of the Tian Yao Clan.

Regarding Lu Xue’s problem, the head of the Tian Yao clan directly added fuel to the current situation, and made up a mess and told Lu Xue.

What helps the human race restore its former glory is just fearing the strength of the human race, and the greed arises after the human race becomes stronger, so the Heavenly Demon race dare not resist.

Lu Xue naturally understood the meaning of the patriarch of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Looking at the disgraceful look of the leader of the Tiandemon Clan, she knew that this was probably the same as the current situation of the demon clan today.

The strong prey on the weak, this world is so realistic.

Lu Xue slowly looked up and her eyes looked into the sky through the ceiling.

She murmured in her heart, Dad, you said back then that we should protect the peace of the human race forever, have you ever thought about peace in other races?

If Lu Daosheng heard Lu Xue's words here, he would definitely disagree.

"What does the matter of the tribe have to do with me?"

That's right, Lu Daosheng is like this. What he wants to do is just to protect the people around him.

What does other people's safety have to do with him?

He could not have taken care of so comprehensively.

Moreover, the human race was weak back then, and no one else had ever stood up to protect the human race.

Time is fate.

The main reason why Lu Xue can think so is because of Ao Qing.

After all, Ao Qing has received favor from the Tian Yao Clan, so this time he just wants to repay his personal favor.

Does Ao Qing really care about the Heavenly Demon Clan?

Perhaps Ao Qing had really had a few feelings for the Heavenly Demon Clan, but definitely not much.

What's more, all the old friends in the Tiande Clan have left.

After this incident, Ao Qing was afraid that he would have no chance to have another relationship with the Heavenly Demon Clan.

"My Lord, why don't the whole treaty be done, let the shemale tribes never be enemies."

"hehe."

Lu Xue rolled her eyes directly about Ao Qing's suggestion.

How could a treaty work so well?

As long as you have the strength, the treaty is nothing.

Unless it is a treaty made by the power that surpasses the entire Chaos Realm.

For example, your own father.

After pondering for a while, Lu Xue was already a little irritated.

Are you too concerned about the demon race?

Thinking of this, Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing and asked in an inner voice that only the two of them could hear, "Xiaoqing, to be honest, do you really want to help the Tian Yao Clan?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ao Qing was stunned and said, "My little master, am I repaying my kindness?"

"really?"

"Uh, come here and have a look and show off."

"you!"

Lu Xue's chest was undulating and she glared at Ao Qing.

At the same time, she also understood that Ao Qing, a heartless thing, could really help the Tian Yao Clan.

After a long time, I became a clown.

However, this trip did not come in vain. At least I know that the human race is really fierce in its development.

"Captain of the Heavenly Demon Clan, I will let the race restrain itself a little. Your Heavenly Demon Clan can develop with peace of mind recently."

"At the same time, I will leave you a wisp of the blood of the Heavenly Demon, which can be regarded as repaying the kindness of the Xuanzun clan leader back then."

The leader of the Xuanzun clan, the elderly old turtle of the Heavenly Demon clan back then.

It was him who helped Ao Qing get luck in the Tiande Clan.

After hearing Lu Xue's words, the leader of the Tian Yao Clan also understood what Lu Xue meant.

I'm afraid it's almost impossible to ask Ao Qing for help in the future.

However, that's enough.

With Lu Xue's words, the Heavenly Demon Clan will definitely not be affected by any other reason recently, and the strength of the clan can be restored.

At the same time, there is also a ray of blood of the sky demon, which is the most important thing!

At this time, Lu Xue left Ao Qing and Bai Ling.

"Senior stay!"

Lu Xue stopped and looked back at the patriarch of the Heavenly Demon Clan, frowned slightly.

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan hesitated for a while, and pointed to Bai Ling beside Lu Xue and said, "Senior Lu, this girl seems to be from my Tian Yao Clan."

"I took it away, are there any problems?"
